XenotypeDef.label: charmweaver
XenotypeDef.description:
Charmweavers are a type of archotech-enhanced xenohuman related to sanguophages. Powered by archites, their abilities go far beyond normal genetic enhancements. They are socially adept and inhumanly beautiful. They are weak combatants and prefer to use their natural psychic ability to enthral others and make them do their bidding. While they do not age, they are still susceptible to disease, poison and a violent death. A charmweaver can make new charmweavers by reimplanting their own xenogerm into a person.

Charmweavers must regularly consume hemogen derived from human blood, which they prefer to do while lovin’. Engaging sexually with a charmweaver can lead to unforeseen consequences, as their bodies are able to sustain multiple pregnancies at the same time, even by multiple partners.

Charmweavers and sanguophages have closely linked origins and share many traits, even though they are quite different today. The granddaughter of the first sanguophage, Varan-Du, sought to rid herself of the curse he had bestowed upon her, but in doing so repeated his mistake. When she tried to control the very same hyperintelligent archotech to become a baseliner again, it transformed her instead into something different. Every charmweaver is descended from her and is also hunted, but often for very different reasons. Their appearance made it impossible to hide, so most of them seek out less developed worlds where they can hide or enter the service of powerful figures.

Their numbers are unknown but are considered to be extremely low. Some think they are legends or rare irrelevancies; others see them as demons from ancient religions, to be hunted and killed.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Charmweavers are ageless, irresistible superhumans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are inhumanly beautiful and extremely charming. They can psychically influence others and turn them into their servants. They avoid combat, letting others do the fighting for them. The price is that charmweavers must consume hemogen derived from human blood to survive and are addicted to being in romantic relationships with others. They often cause social issues in the community they are part of.
